sovereign-ai-federation-v2.caption: Proposed campus-controlled release path. Authorization and budget reservation must precede the operating-system send boundary; later receipt and charge reconciliation do not retroactively authorize a forbidden submission. This is a conditional design, not a deployed system.

The proposed 90-day comparison asks whether federation adds useful, policy-permitted service beyond a gateway that already permits separately approved external access. Paired task quality, safety, and actual cost must be evaluated separately; no pilot result is available.
